rule.name: LinearLookupInLoop
rule.message: This stream scans the whole collection for one key on every pass of the enclosing loop or stream, and the collection does not change in between. Build a Map keyed by that value once, before the loop (collect(Collectors.toMap(Route::path, Function.identity()))), and use get or containsKey (a Set of keys for anyMatch). An exception fits only for a collection that always stays a handful of items.
